description: Alias table format. It maps a reference colour, layer, or label cluster to one stable element id, by hand. A cluster or layer with no entry here is listed as unnamed in the ledger, never silently named. Every entry states its basis, so a wrong alias is visible and checkable. No entry invents a text: a label cluster is matched by position, never by OCR, because no OCR exists in the toolchain.

basis.description: Why this mapping holds, in plain words, with the evidence (trace file, frame, or colour).

id.description: Stable element id shared with the scene and with other ledgers.

kind.description: colour: one flat colour mask. colour-layer: one named layer from checker.layout.segment_frame (sudan, base, rsf, october, white_text). label-cluster: one bright-text cluster matched by position.

near_xy.description: Centre in px, in 1920x1080 space, for kind 'label-cluster'. The cluster whose first-sample centroid is nearest this point, within window_px, takes this id.

tolerance.description: RGB euclidean tolerance for a colour match, or null for label clusters.

window_px.description: Match window in px for kind 'label-cluster'.

z.description: Layer order from the scene, or null when the element has no separate z (for example map interior).

title: hme alias 1.0: hand mapping from reference colour or cluster to element id
